description: Defines a data structure for device identity, including key generation, signing, and file storage functionalities related to device cryptographic identities within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A data structure representing the device's cryptographic identity including device ID, public and private keys, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Determines the directory URL for storing device state, checking environment variables or default locations.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity from file or creates a new one if not available.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string with the device's private key, returning a Base64 URL-encoded signature.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with cryptographic keys and device ID.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes data into a Base64 URL-safe string.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the device's public key encoded in Base64 URL format.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Determines the file URL for storing the device identity JSON.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the device identity data to disk in JSON format.
